description:
Months of war and a blockade have battered Iran. Its navy is at the bottom of the Persian Gulf. Its air force is destroyed. Its economy is in ruins.

Still, after the dust settles, the Iranian regime could end up in a stronger financial position than before the war began—raising concerns among some Republicans about the emerging deal.

Is this developing agreement really good for America? A CNN NewsNight panel weighs in.

author: CNN
description:
Ukraine has launched the largest drone offensive on Moscow of the full-scale war, in an attack that damaged a key oil refinery, caused fires, and sent debris raining down across the region. 

Air defenses shot down at least 194 drones bound for the Russian capital overnight into Thursday, according to Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin. That’s far higher than other days of heavy attacks in recent months, when drones only numbered in the double digits. 

CNN’s Sebastian Shukla has details of the drone attack and CNN’s Christina Macfarlane speaks with Russia analyst Nigel Gould-Davies.

0:00 Ukrainian drones strike residential buildings and an oil refinery in Moscow 
2:36 Volodymyr Zelensky speaks about Ukraine’s military strength ahead of the attack 
4:29 Russia expert calls attack an “unignorable sign” of the war turning against Russia 
8:07 Is Trump shifting his support to Ukraine?

Watch more CNN
title: Ukraine launches largest attack on Moscow since war started
